reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, round-2 fix-verification batch

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Competency requires dividing by a 1-DIGIT number, but seed 42 asks 'What is 670 ÷ 10?' where 10 is a two-digit divisor, directly exceeding the stated scope.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The other 4 seeds (30÷2, 300÷5, 200÷4, 108÷2) do stay within the 1-digit-divisor scope, so only 1 of 5 samples is out of bounds, but that one is a clear scope violation.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The bare 'What is X ÷ Y?' phrasing is clear and appropriate reading-level for Grade 3 Q4.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: No sample includes any word-problem or money framing despite 'including problems involving money' being explicit in the competency text; all 5 are bare division facts.

competency_alignment.rationale: Dividing 670 by 10 (seed 42) is a different, easier skill (dividing by a power of ten) than the 1-digit-divisor long-division skill this competency targets, so it does not test the intended concept.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Dividends (30-670) appropriately span the stated 2- to 3-digit range for Grade 3 Q4 division.
